title: Was the Patriots' loss to Green Bay a bad sign or a bad day?
text: The Boston Sports Journal’s Mike Giardi joins for another live Monday night show to break down the film of the Patriots' blowout loss to Green Bay. title: Josh Allen & Carson Wentz wear down Vikings defense, Bills win 23-6
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: In the Week 9 preview show, we billed Packers-Patriots as "an absolute shootout." Bills-Vikings was...mostly the opposite of that. Carson Wentz turned the ball over almost as many times as he missed Justin Jefferson. It took three quarters for Josh Allen and the Bills to really find their footing against the Vikings suffocating defense. But in the end, did we actually learn anything new about these teams? Derrik Klassen and Dave Helman break down every silly bit of the Buffalo Bills win over the Minnesota Vikings.
